title: ESA WorldCover, 11 land-cover classes
version: WorldCover 2020 (v100) and 2021 (v200); Product User Manual v2.0 (2022-10-24)
license_note: Codes, class names and RGB colours from Table 3 'Coding of the Map layer and definition of the classes' of the Product User Manual v2.0; hex values converted from the RGB triples.
note: 10 m global land cover from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2, classes defined with the FAO Land Cover Classification System. Land cover only: built-up excludes urban green, which falls into tree cover or grassland; lawn, meadow and pasture all fall into grassland. Codes are the byte values of the Map layer. Successor products after v200 were not checked.

entries.name: Tree cover
entries.note: Tree cover of 10 % or more, incl. plantations and tree crops (e.g. olive trees); other covers may lie below the canopy.

entries.name: Shrubland
entries.note: Natural shrubs below 5 m, cover 10 % or more.

entries.name: Grassland
entries.note: Any natural herbaceous cover incl. pastures; lawns fall here too.

entries.name: Cropland
entries.note: Annual cropland; perennial woody crops are tree cover or shrubland, greenhouses are built-up.

entries.name: Built-up
entries.note: Buildings, roads, railways and other structures; urban green (parks, sport facilities) is not included.

entries.name: Bare / sparse vegetation
entries.note: Exposed soil, sand or rock with never more than 10 % vegetation; also waste dumps and extraction sites.

entries.name: Permanent water bodies
entries.note: Lakes, reservoirs and rivers; rivers -> watercourse.

entries.name: Herbaceous wetland
entries.note: Herbaceous vegetation permanently or regularly flooded; excludes swamp forest (tree cover).

entries.name: Mangroves
entries.note: Tropical intertidal woody vegetation; nearest drawing is wet woodland.
